thread:
Lara: Kickoff for Verdant case + webinar. Need interview slots, a short benchmark stat for the blog, final pull quote signoff, and legal embargo. Can we wrap by next Tue?

Derek: I can lock interviews. Prefer Wed 11:00 or Thu 2:00 PT. 20m each.

Sasha: For benchmark, I'll run a quick median-latency sweep on their anonymized prompts in staging. Aim to surface one line like "~2.7x median latency improvement in our tests" + appendix link. Need customer permission to run.

Mohit: Assets: final quote, 2 headshots, SVG logo, and a 15s social clip. I'll prep hero comps once quote is final.

Lara: Draft quote: ```
"Redwood helped us deliver summaries fast enough to meaningfully reduce clinician wait times."
```

legal-bot: Suggest adding attribution and avoiding absolutes. Recommend: "In our tests, Redwood reduced inference latency in our environment, helping reduce clinician wait times." Also check there is no PHI in the transcript. Typical turnaround 48-72h.

Lara: Updated per legal: "In our tests, Redwood reduced inference latency in our environment, helping reduce clinician wait times." Can legal confirm?

legal-bot: Approved with minor edit: swap "clinician wait times" -> "care team wait times" for broader phrasing. Final: "In our tests, Redwood reduced inference latency in our environment, helping reduce care team wait times." Marking green absent external redlines.

Sasha: Perf job scheduled Thu 08:30 PT. Will post stat + appendix link here when complete.

Derek: Sent invites for Wed 11:00 PT (CEO) and Wed 11:25 PT (Head of Product). Included draft consent on calendar: "I consent to be contacted about this case study and to receive follow-up from Redwood."

ops-bot: Routing set: utm_campaign=verdant_launch; tag=verdant-case; leads -> /queues/enterprise-sdr. Consent param saved as consent_marketing=true.

Mohit: Uploaded hero draft and placeholder social frames. Holding until quote + headshots finalized.

Sasha: Results: median latency 98ms vs 265ms baseline -> "~2.7x median latency improvement (in our tests)". Appendix: https://app.internal/benchmarks/verdant-1745678900.

Lara: Great. Customer requested embargo until the 14th. Legal says should be fine provided no further redlines.

Derek: Action list: confirm interviews (done), perf stat + appendix (Sasha), legal signoff (legal-bot), assets (Mohit), lead routing (ops-bot). Following up Mon AM to confirm final publish package.

Lara: Thanks team.
